editorial.overview: The HCIP-Security certification exam is administered directly by Huawei to evaluate your technical knowledge and understanding across six core domains. These standard domains include network security fundamentals, firewalls, intrusion prevention, advanced VPN technologies, identity management, and specific Huawei security product configurations designed for modern enterprise networking environments and infrastructure operations.
editorial.who_should_take: Network engineers, professional security administrators, and technical support staff with networking experience who configure, deploy, and manage enterprise security infrastructures and networks.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review official Huawei documentation and exam guides to understand every expected objective. Study network layer security concepts, packet filtering rules, and IKE protocols carefully. Test and verify your configurations in a lab environment to prepare effectively for complex product management scenarios and practical troubleshooting tasks across all 60 questions.

domain_guidance.summary: This domain covers the core principles of network security architecture, communication layers, and security controls required to protect modern enterprise network environments against various evolving cyber threats effectively.

This domain focuses heavily on firewall architectures, packet filters, and intrusion prevention mechanisms designed to inspect traffic and block malicious intrusions effectively across the entire enterprise network infrastructure.

This domain examines important VPN technologies, IPsec protocols, and Internet Key Exchange mechanisms that ensure secure data transmission and encrypted tunnels across public networks for connected enterprise branches.

This domain addresses identity verification protocols, peer authentication models, and strict access control policies that ensure only authorized users and trusted devices gain entry to sensitive corporate network resources.

This domain details the step-by-step configuration, implementation, and deployment procedures of Huawei security products and specific features to establish security perimeters and defend enterprise networks reliably during daily operations.

This domain explores daily security operations, maintenance procedures, advanced troubleshooting techniques, and structured incident response tasks necessary to maintain continuous network availability and rapid threat mitigation throughout the infrastructure.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Arrive at the designated testing center early with valid identification ready for verification. Carefully manage your time across the 60 questions within the strict 120-minute duration.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The exam contains exactly 60 questions covering multiple distinct domains of enterprise security technologies, requiring candidates to demonstrate both theoretical knowledge and practical configuration understanding.
The passing score is 60 on a scaled score range of 0 to 1000, aligning with standard Huawei certification requirements for professional level written examinations.
The total exam duration is 120 minutes, which gives test takers adequate time to read, analyze, and answer all questions presented during the testing session without rushing.
The official exam registration price is $300.0, which must be paid when scheduling your testing appointment through the authorized certification registration channels provided by Huawei.
